# Country scope (BYZ). Classical Roman 4 Praetorian Prefectures & 12 Dioceses effects.

oe_prf_auth_add = {
    if = {
        limit = { exists = international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars }
        international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars = {
            change_variable = { name = oe_pillars_authority add = $amount$ }
            clamp_variable = { name = oe_pillars_authority min = 0 max = 100 }
        }
    }
}

# Ensure the repurposed Sacrum Consistorium IO (oe_byz_policy_org) exists and BYZ presides over it.
oe_prf_found_consistorium = {
	if = {
		limit = { exists = international_organization:oe_byz_policy_org }
	    save_scope_as = oe_prf_emperor
	    if = {
	        limit = { NOT = { exists = international_organization:oe_byz_policy_org } }
	        create_international_organization = {
	            type = international_organization_type:oe_byz_policy_org
	            add_country_to_international_organization = scope:oe_prf_emperor
	            set_leader_country = scope:oe_prf_emperor
	            international_organization_add_special_status = {
	                type = special_status:oe_byz_policy_org_real_empire_king
	                country = scope:oe_prf_emperor
	            }
	        }
	    }
	    else = {
	        international_organization:oe_byz_policy_org = {
	            if = {
	                limit = { NOT = { scope:oe_prf_emperor = { is_member_of_international_organization = international_organization:oe_byz_policy_org } } }
	                add_country_to_international_organization = scope:oe_prf_emperor
	            }
	            if = {
	                limit = { NOT = { scope:oe_prf_emperor = { has_special_status_in_international_organization = { type = special_status:oe_byz_policy_org_real_empire_king international_organization = international_organization:oe_byz_policy_org } } } }
	                international_organization_add_special_status = {
	                    type = special_status:oe_byz_policy_org_real_empire_king
	                    country = scope:oe_prf_emperor
	                }
	            }
	        }
	    }
	    oe_prf_sync_consistorium_members = yes
	}
}

# Enroll eligible imperial exarchates, senior themes, and outer Roman clients into oe_byz_policy_org.
oe_prf_sync_consistorium_members = {
    if = {
        limit = { exists = international_organization:oe_byz_policy_org }
        every_subject = {
            limit = {
                oe_prf_subject_real_power = yes
                NOT = { is_member_of_international_organization = international_organization:oe_byz_policy_org }
            }
            save_scope_as = oe_prf_enroll
            international_organization:oe_byz_policy_org = {
                add_country_to_international_organization = scope:oe_prf_enroll
                international_organization_add_special_status = {
                    type = special_status:oe_byz_policy_org_real_power_country
                    country = scope:oe_prf_enroll
                }
            }
        }
        every_subject = {
            limit = {
                oe_prf_subject_client = yes
                NOT = { is_member_of_international_organization = international_organization:oe_byz_policy_org }
            }
            save_scope_as = oe_prf_enroll
            international_organization:oe_byz_policy_org = {
                add_country_to_international_organization = scope:oe_prf_enroll
                international_organization_add_special_status = {
                    type = special_status:oe_byz_policy_org_low_power_country
                    country = scope:oe_prf_enroll
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

oe_prf_pick_next_diocese = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_prf_pending_dio value = 0 }
    if = {
        limit = { oe_prf_dio_1_eligible = yes NOT = { var:oe_prf_dio_1 ?= 1 } NOT = { var:oe_prf_dio_1 ?= 2 } }
        set_variable = { name = oe_prf_pending_dio value = 1 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { oe_prf_dio_2_eligible = yes NOT = { var:oe_prf_dio_2 ?= 1 } NOT = { var:oe_prf_dio_2 ?= 2 } }
        set_variable = { name = oe_prf_pending_dio value = 2 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { oe_prf_dio_3_eligible = yes NOT = { var:oe_prf_dio_3 ?= 1 } NOT = { var:oe_prf_dio_3 ?= 2 } }

oe_prf_apply_pending_diocese = {
    if = { limit = { var:oe_prf_pending_dio ?= 1 } set_variable = { name = oe_prf_dio_1 value = $mode$ } }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_prf_pending_dio ?= 2 } set_variable = { name = oe_prf_dio_2 value = $mode$ } }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_prf_pending_dio ?= 3 } set_variable = { name = oe_prf_dio_3 value = $mode$ } }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_prf_pending_dio ?= 4 } set_variable = { name = oe_prf_dio_4 value = $mode$ } }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_prf_pending_dio ?= 5 } set_variable = { name = oe_prf_dio_5 value = $mode$ } }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_prf_pending_dio ?= 6 } set_variable = { name = oe_prf_dio_6 value = $mode$ } }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_prf_pending_dio ?= 7 } set_variable = { name = oe_prf_dio_7 value = $mode$ } }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_prf_pending_dio ?= 8 } set_variable = { name = oe_prf_dio_8 value = $mode$ } }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_prf_pending_dio ?= 9 } set_variable = { name = oe_prf_dio_9 value = $mode$ } }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_prf_pending_dio ?= 10 } set_variable = { name = oe_prf_dio_10 value = $mode$ } }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_prf_pending_dio ?= 11 } set_variable = { name = oe_prf_dio_11 value = $mode$ } }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_prf_pending_dio ?= 12 } set_variable = { name = oe_prf_dio_12 value = $mode$ } }
    set_variable = { name = oe_prf_pending_dio value = 0 }
    oe_prf_sync_modifiers = yes
}

oe_prf_dispatch_job = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_prf_job value = $job$ }
    trigger_event_silently = oe_prf.91
}

# Hidden worker (called from oe_prf.91).
oe_prf_work = {
    if = { limit = { var:oe_prf_job ?= 1 } set_variable = { name = oe_prf_charter value = 1 } oe_prf_found_consistorium = yes oe_prf_sync_modifiers = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_prf_job ?= 2 } set_variable = { name = oe_prf_charter value = 2 } oe_prf_found_consistorium = yes oe_prf_sync_modifiers = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_prf_job ?= 3 } set_variable = { name = oe_prf_charter value = 3 } oe_prf_found_consistorium = yes oe_prf_sync_modifiers = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_prf_job ?= 11 } oe_prf_set_pref_1 = { mode = 1 } }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_prf_job ?= 12 } oe_prf_set_pref_1 = { mode = 2 } }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_prf_job ?= 21 } oe_prf_set_pref_2 = { mode = 1 } }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_prf_job ?= 22 } oe_prf_set_pref_2 = { mode = 2 } }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_prf_job ?= 31 } oe_prf_set_pref_3 = { mode = 1 } }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_prf_job ?= 32 } oe_prf_set_pref_3 = { mode = 2 } }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_prf_job ?= 41 } oe_prf_set_pref_4 = { mode = 1 } }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_prf_job ?= 42 } oe_prf_set_pref_4 = { mode = 2 } }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_prf_job ?= 51 } oe_prf_apply_pending_diocese = { mode = 1 } }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_prf_job ?= 52 } oe_prf_apply_pending_diocese = { mode = 2 } }
    else_if = {
        limit = { var:oe_prf_job ?= 61 }
        # Convert first Military Prefecture back to Senatorial Civil (from oe_prf.7 option c).
        if = { limit = { var:oe_prf_mode_1 ?= 2 } oe_prf_set_pref_1 = { mode = 1 } }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_prf_mode_2 ?= 2 } oe_prf_set_pref_2 = { mode = 1 } }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_prf_mode_3 ?= 2 } oe_prf_set_pref_3 = { mode = 1 } }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_prf_mode_4 ?= 2 } oe_prf_set_pref_4 = { mode = 1 } }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { var:oe_prf_job ?= 70 }
        # Convene Consistorium action: sync members & modifiers, then open readout oe_prf.90.
        oe_prf_found_consistorium = yes
        oe_prf_sync_modifiers = yes
        trigger_event_non_silently = oe_prf.90
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { var:oe_prf_job ?= 71 }
        # Invest Diocese action: pick next eligible unorganized diocese and fire oe_prf.6.
        oe_prf_pick_next_diocese = yes
        if = {
            limit = { has_variable = oe_prf_pending_dio var:oe_prf_pending_dio >= 1 }
            trigger_event_non_silently = oe_prf.6
        }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { var:oe_prf_job ?= 72 }
        # Reform Prefecture action: cycle through active Prefectures (1..4) and reopen its charter event.
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_prf_reform_target } } set_variable = { name = oe_prf_reform_target value = 0 } }
        change_variable = { name = oe_prf_reform_target add = 1 }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_prf_reform_target > 4 } set_variable = { name = oe_prf_reform_target value = 1 } }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_prf_reform_target ?= 1 OR = { var:oe_prf_mode_1 ?= 1 var:oe_prf_mode_1 ?= 2 } } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_prf.2 }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_prf_reform_target ?= 2 OR = { var:oe_prf_mode_2 ?= 1 var:oe_prf_mode_2 ?= 2 } } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_prf.3 }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_prf_reform_target ?= 3 OR = { var:oe_prf_mode_3 ?= 1 var:oe_prf_mode_3 ?= 2 } } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_prf.4 }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_prf_reform_target ?= 4 OR = { var:oe_prf_mode_4 ?= 1 var:oe_prf_mode_4 ?= 2 } } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_prf.5 }
        else_if = { limit = { OR = { var:oe_prf_mode_1 ?= 1 var:oe_prf_mode_1 ?= 2 } } set_variable = { name = oe_prf_reform_target value = 1 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_prf.2 }
        else_if = { limit = { OR = { var:oe_prf_mode_2 ?= 1 var:oe_prf_mode_2 ?= 2 } } set_variable = { name = oe_prf_reform_target value = 2 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_prf.3 }
        else_if = { limit = { OR = { var:oe_prf_mode_3 ?= 1 var:oe_prf_mode_3 ?= 2 } } set_variable = { name = oe_prf_reform_target value = 3 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_prf.4 }
        else_if = { limit = { OR = { var:oe_prf_mode_4 ?= 1 var:oe_prf_mode_4 ?= 2 } } set_variable = { name = oe_prf_reform_target value = 4 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_prf.5 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { var:oe_prf_job ?= 73 }
        oe_prf_sync_consistorium_members = yes
        oe_prf_sync_modifiers = yes
    }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_prf_job ?= 81 } add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_prf_notitia_codified years = -1 mode = replace } oe_prf_sync_modifiers = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_prf_job ?= 82 } add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_prf_notitia_imperium years = -1 mode = replace } oe_prf_sync_modifiers = yes }
    remove_variable = oe_prf_job
}

# Scheduler slot 43 monthly pulse (BYZ scope; hooked via gen_mainline_lock.py row 43).
oe_prf_monthly = {
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_prf_init } }
        set_variable = oe_prf_init
        set_variable = { name = oe_prf_wait value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_prf_pending_dio value = 0 }
    }
    # 1. Seamless oe_ar_burden (Imperial Strain) monthly relief once Restoration burden is active.
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_ar_strain oe_prf_strain_relief < 0 }
        oe_ar_add_strain = { amount = oe_prf_strain_relief }
    }
    # 2. Annual January sync of Consistorium membership & seat modifiers (lightweight, zero world scan).
    if = {
        limit = { current_month = 1 has_variable = oe_prf_done_1 }
        oe_prf_sync_consistorium_members = yes
        oe_prf_sync_modifiers = yes
    }
    # 3. Progressive event dispatcher (respects shared main-line lock with 4-month force cap).
    if = {
        limit = { oe_prf_tier_1_ok = yes }
        if = {
            limit = {
                OR = {
                    oe_ml_free = yes
                    AND = { has_variable = oe_prf_wait var:oe_prf_wait >= 4 }
                }
            }
            # .1 Founding of the Praetorian Consistorium (at oe_rr_count >= 3 or Restoration)
            if = {
                limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_prf_done_1 } }
                set_variable = oe_prf_done_1
                set_variable = { name = oe_prf_wait value = 0 }
                oe_ml_take_as = { line = 43 }
                trigger_event_non_silently = oe_prf.1
            }
            # .2 Oriens Prefecture Charter
            else_if = {
                limit = { has_variable = oe_prf_done_1 NOT = { has_variable = oe_prf_offered_1 } oe_prf_pref_1_eligible = yes }
                set_variable = oe_prf_offered_1
                set_variable = { name = oe_prf_wait value = 0 }
                oe_ml_take_as = { line = 43 }
                trigger_event_non_silently = oe_prf.2
            }
            # .3 Illyricum Prefecture Charter
            else_if = {
                limit = { has_variable = oe_prf_done_1 NOT = { has_variable = oe_prf_offered_2 } oe_prf_pref_2_eligible = yes }
                set_variable = oe_prf_offered_2
                set_variable = { name = oe_prf_wait value = 0 }
                oe_ml_take_as = { line = 43 }
                trigger_event_non_silently = oe_prf.3
            }
            # .4 Italia et Africa Prefecture Charter (Tier 2: oe_rr_count >= 6 or Restoration)
            else_if = {
                limit = { has_variable = oe_prf_done_1 NOT = { has_variable = oe_prf_offered_3 } oe_prf_pref_3_eligible = yes }
                set_variable = oe_prf_offered_3
                set_variable = { name = oe_prf_wait value = 0 }
                oe_ml_take_as = { line = 43 }
                trigger_event_non_silently = oe_prf.4
            }
            # .5 Galliae Prefecture Charter (Tier 2: oe_rr_count >= 6 or Restoration)
            else_if = {
                limit = { has_variable = oe_prf_done_1 NOT = { has_variable = oe_prf_offered_4 } oe_prf_pref_4_eligible = yes }
                set_variable = oe_prf_offered_4
                set_variable = { name = oe_prf_wait value = 0 }
                oe_ml_take_as = { line = 43 }
                trigger_event_non_silently = oe_prf.5
            }
            # .8 Four Prefectures Milestone (all 4 chartered & >= 8 dioceses OR Tier 3 + all 4 chartered)
            else_if = {
                limit = {
                    has_variable = oe_prf_done_1
                    NOT = { has_variable = oe_prf_done_8 }
                    oe_prf_all_four_active = yes
                    OR = { oe_prf_active_dioceses >= 8 oe_prf_tier_3_ok = yes }
                }
                set_variable = oe_prf_done_8
                set_variable = { name = oe_prf_wait value = 0 }
                oe_ml_take_as = { line = 43 }
                trigger_event_non_silently = oe_prf.8
            }
            # .6 Automatic Diocese Vicarius prompt every 3 years while eligible unorganized Dioceses remain
            else_if = {
                limit = {
                    has_variable = oe_prf_done_1
                    NOT = { has_variable = oe_prf_dio_auto_cd }
                    oe_prf_has_eligible_unorganized_dio = yes
                }
                oe_prf_pick_next_diocese = yes
                if = {
                    limit = { has_variable = oe_prf_pending_dio var:oe_prf_pending_dio >= 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = oe_prf_dio_auto_cd years = 3 }
                    set_variable = { name = oe_prf_wait value = 0 }
                    oe_ml_take_as = { line = 43 }
                    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_prf.6
                }
            }
            # .7 Overmighty Praetorian Exarch crisis (only when Military Prefecture exists & strain/instability high)
            else_if = {
                limit = {
                    has_variable = oe_prf_done_1
                    NOT = { has_variable = oe_prf_crisis_cd }
                    oe_prf_can_trigger_crisis = yes
                }
                random = {
                    chance = 4
                    set_variable = { name = oe_prf_crisis_cd years = 12 }
                    set_variable = { name = oe_prf_wait value = 0 }
                    oe_ml_take_as = { line = 43 }
                    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_prf.7
                }
            }
        }
        else = {
            # Main-line lock busy: count waiting months only when an event is ready.
            if = {
                limit = {
                    OR = {
                        NOT = { has_variable = oe_prf_done_1 }
                        AND = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_prf_offered_1 } oe_prf_pref_1_eligible = yes }
                        AND = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_prf_offered_2 } oe_prf_pref_2_eligible = yes }
                        AND = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_prf_offered_3 } oe_prf_pref_3_eligible = yes }
                        AND = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_prf_offered_4 } oe_prf_pref_4_eligible = yes }
                    }
                }
                change_variable = { name = oe_prf_wait add = 1 }
            }
        }
    }
}

# --- Test harness helpers (called ONLY from oebyz_dev_test DEV_LINES, NEVER from player actions/events) ---
oe_prf_test_init = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_rr_count } } set_variable = { name = oe_rr_count value = 3 } }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_rr_count < 3 } set_variable = { name = oe_rr_count value = 3 } }
    set_variable = oe_prf_done_1
    oe_prf_found_consistorium = yes
    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_prf.1
}

oe_prf_test_all = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_rr_count value = 10 }
    set_variable = oe_prf_done_1
    oe_prf_set_pref_1 = { mode = 1 }
    oe_prf_set_pref_2 = { mode = 2 }
    oe_prf_set_pref_3 = { mode = 1 }
    oe_prf_set_pref_4 = { mode = 2 }
}

oe_prf_test_dio = {
    oe_prf_pick_next_diocese = yes
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_prf_pending_dio } } set_variable = { name = oe_prf_pending_dio value = 1 } }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_prf_pending_dio < 1 } set_variable = { name = oe_prf_pending_dio value = 1 } }
    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_prf.6
}

oe_prf_clear = {
    remove_variable = oe_prf_init
    remove_variable = oe_prf_done_1
    remove_variable = oe_prf_done_8
    remove_variable = oe_prf_charter
    remove_variable = oe_prf_pending_dio
    remove_variable = oe_prf_wait
    remove_variable = oe_prf_crisis_cd
    remove_variable = oe_prf_dio_auto_cd
    remove_variable = oe_prf_job

    remove_variable = oe_prf_mode_1
    remove_variable = oe_prf_offered_1
    remove_country_modifier = oe_prf_oriens_civil
    remove_country_modifier = oe_prf_oriens_mil
    remove_variable = oe_prf_mode_2
    remove_variable = oe_prf_offered_2
    remove_country_modifier = oe_prf_illyricum_civil
    remove_country_modifier = oe_prf_illyricum_mil

    remove_variable = oe_prf_offered_3

    remove_country_modifier = oe_prf_italia_mil

    remove_variable = oe_prf_offered_4
    remove_country_modifier = oe_prf_galliae_civil
    remove_country_modifier = oe_prf_galliae_foederati
    remove_variable = oe_prf_dio_1
    location:constantinople = { remove_location_modifier = oe_prf_dio_seat_civil remove_location_modifier = oe_prf_dio_seat_mil }
    remove_variable = oe_prf_dio_2
    location:smyrna = { remove_location_modifier = oe_prf_dio_seat_civil remove_location_modifier = oe_prf_dio_seat_mil }

    location:alexandria = { remove_location_modifier = oe_prf_dio_seat_civil remove_location_modifier = oe_prf_dio_seat_mil }
    remove_variable = oe_prf_dio_6
    location:thessaloniki = { remove_location_modifier = oe_prf_dio_seat_civil remove_location_modifier = oe_prf_dio_seat_mil }
    remove_variable = oe_prf_dio_7
    location:belgrad = { remove_location_modifier = oe_prf_dio_seat_civil remove_location_modifier = oe_prf_dio_seat_mil }
    remove_variable = oe_prf_dio_8
    location:buda = { remove_location_modifier = oe_prf_dio_seat_civil remove_location_modifier = oe_prf_dio_seat_mil }
    remove_variable = oe_prf_dio_9
    location:ravenna = { remove_location_modifier = oe_prf_dio_seat_civil remove_location_modifier = oe_prf_dio_seat_mil }
    remove_variable = oe_prf_dio_10
    location:tunis = { remove_location_modifier = oe_prf_dio_seat_civil remove_location_modifier = oe_prf_dio_seat_mil }
    remove_variable = oe_prf_dio_11
    location:lyon = { remove_location_modifier = oe_prf_dio_seat_civil remove_location_modifier = oe_prf_dio_seat_mil }
    remove_variable = oe_prf_dio_12
    location:trier = { remove_location_modifier = oe_prf_dio_seat_civil remove_location_modifier = oe_prf_dio_seat_mil }
    remove_country_modifier = oe_prf_balance_civil
    remove_country_modifier = oe_prf_balance_mil

    remove_country_modifier = oe_prf_exarch_curbed
}

oe_prf_log = {
    debug_log = "OE_PRF tier=[ROOT.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_prf_unlock_tier')|0] pref=[ROOT.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_prf_active_prefectures')|0] (civ=[ROOT.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_prf_civil_prefectures')|0] mil=[ROOT.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_prf_mil_prefectures')|0]) dio=[ROOT.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_prf_active_dioceses')|0]/12 relief=[ROOT.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_prf_strain_relief')|2]"
}
